description: §14.8.9 S443 round 6b — merging two protect-tagged rows UNIONS their protected columns, and a reveal on one source never un-strips a column another source protects: `{...a, ...b.reveal("pin")}` ships {id, name} only.
rationale: §14.8.9: the floor strips every column whose origin is protected unless `reveal`-declassified AT THE VALUE. Round 6 kept one descriptor per object, so the second spread REPLACED the first: `{...a, ...b}` shipped passwordHash and `{...a, ...b.reveal("pin")}` shipped hash + pin (review, measured over HTTP). One marker per column unions by construction.
